description:
Boardman beginnings, providing little ones with the cycling foundations they can build on as they grow and gain confidence.

As with all the JNR models, quality is key and always starts with the frame. The small yet perfectly formed triple-butted aluminium frame and fork keep weight low, and the single down tube construction upfront allows greater standover clearance for those finding their feet astride two wheels.

Wide, fast-rolling tyres reduce bumps and vibration to build confidence, and as this grows and the speeds increase, the adjustable reach brake lever is designed for tiny hands to help even the smallest of speedsters to slow their roll.

Inevitably toddlers get tired or distracted, and parents always end up having to carry the bike around. Having experienced this ourselves, we included a simple carry handle in the back of the balance bike-sized saddle, making things comfy for both child and parent alike.
